answer: Because the wharf decay is applied at each close, the forge audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the fable fee to keep them eligible. A juror that skips cases loses 35% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A 312 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
